context: Define route ownership explicitly: internal /results routes use SPA navigation; /docs and other site-owned routes force native navigation; known legacy platform spellings canonicalize once; unknown IDs/slugs render a stable error with actionable recovery. Exercise real clicks and direct HTTP routes against both the browser-test server and a Pages-shaped root 404 artifact.
description: Real-browser review reproduced two flywheel documentation CTAs being intercepted by preact-router and rendered as Explorer 404s. It also confirmed weak recovery for an invalid result ID and a phantom platform option for underscore-form slugs. The workflow-generated Pages fallback itself worked, and unknown-benchmark title handling was correct. Consolidate the real routing defects while adding regression coverage for the claims that were refuted.

anti_patterns.dont: canonicalize every underscore to a hyphen globally
anti_patterns.instead: use the platform registry or an explicit alias map at the platform-route boundary
anti_patterns.why: benchmark/result identifiers may legitimately contain underscores

anti_patterns.dont: fix the CTA test by dispatching synthetic click or popstate events
anti_patterns.instead: use Playwright locator.click and assert the loaded document content and network request
anti_patterns.why: the defect depends on the router's real global click delegation

anti_patterns.dont: replace actionable route errors with silent redirects
anti_patterns.instead: canonicalize known aliases and show recovery controls for genuinely unknown IDs
anti_patterns.why: stale shared links need a clear explanation and recovery path

preserves.behavior: Canonical internal /results links remain client-side and retain base-path behavior.
Canonical platform IDs in data and URLs are not rewritten merely for display.
No redirect loop, history duplication, or phantom switcher option is introduced.
The global header's already-correct absolute documentation links remain correct.
Unknown benchmark routes keep the non-leaking Not found document title and Back to Results recovery.

prior_art.concept: Extend the existing direct-route matrix with real-click and Pages-shaped assertions.
Reuse the canonical absolute documentation destinations already used by the header.
Reuse the established not-found title and recovery presentation rather than inventing route-specific error chrome.
